title: Affine global Hom comparison as sections of sheaf base change
statement: Let R and B be commutative rings, X a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], f:X\to S=\operatorname{Spec}(R) and g:S′=\operatorname{Spec}(B)\to S. Form X′=X\times_S S′ with projections f′ and g_X [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let M\in D(\mathcal O_X) be perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex] and K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X) [def-pc-derived-category], and put H=R\mathcal Hom_X(M,K) [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Write E_g for the fixed derived extension of scalars and α for the canonical affine global Hom comparison [def-pc-affine-global-hom-base-change-map]; global Hom is [def-pc-global-derived-rhom]. There are isomorphisms a:E_g(R\operatorname{Hom}_X(M,K))\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma(S′,Lg^*Rf_*H) and b:R\Gamma(S′,Rf′_*Lg_X^*H)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\operatorname{Hom}_{X′}(Lg_X^*M,Lg_X^*K) such that α=a\,;\,R\Gamma(S′,\mathrm{BC}_H)\,;\,b, where BC_H is the fixed derived sheaf base-change map [def-pc-derived-base-change-map], with pullback and direct image as in [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Derived sections on S′ carry their canonical B-action through ΓSpecIso, equivalently affineDerivedGlobalSections of the identity of S′. No Tor independence is assumed, and no invertibility of BC_H or α is asserted.

proof.text: Put H = R𝓗om_X(M,K). Internal Hom from a perfect complex preserves quasi-coherence, so H is in D_QCoh(X). Since f is qcqs, Rf_*H is in D_QCoh(S).

Derived direct-image composition gives the restricted-sections identification RΓ_X(H) = RΓ_S(Rf_*H), with the R-action from f. Use the isomorphism commuting with the right-derived units and the underived identity on sections.

On the affine bases the quasi-coherent derived equivalence and the tilde/pullback comparison identify Lg^* with derived extension of scalars, by computing on K-flat module representatives. The extension/restriction adjunction descends from these representatives. Compare it with the fixed affineDerivedExtensionAdjunction by uniqueness of left adjoints to the same restriction functor; this preserves the unit. Combine with the preceding sections comparison to construct a.

The perfect tensor-Hom comparison supplies the dual, evaluation and coevaluation exact pairing, and the perfect-dual pullback comparison. Strong monoidal pullback transports the exact pairing. Consequently the evaluation-mate map Lg_X^*H → R𝓗om_X′(Lg_X^*M,Lg_X^*K) is invertible: under the tensor-Hom adjunction its evaluation is the inverse tensor-pullback comparison followed by pullback of evaluation. Apply Rf′_* and RΓ_S′ and the unit-compatible direct-image composition isomorphism to construct b.

Transpose a.hom followed by RΓ_S′ of the fixed sheaf base-change map and b.hom under the derived extension/restriction adjunction. Source-unit compatibility, naturality and the triangle identities identify this transpose with restricted RΓ_X of the evaluation-mate map, followed by the sections/pushforward comparison on X′. Its evaluation and right-derived-unit equations identify it with globalHomPullbackComparison. Injectivity of the Hom equivalence gives the displayed equality. No Tor-independence assumption or invertibility of sheaf base change has been used.

theorem affineGlobalHomBaseChange_factorization
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (A : Type u) [Ring A], HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    {R B : CommRingCat.{u}} {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (f : X ⟶ Spec R) (g : Spec B ⟶ Spec R)
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (M K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hM : Scheme.IsPerfect X M)
    (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X K) :
    let H := (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      X.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj (op M, K)
    let Γ := affineDerivedGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B))
    ∃ a : (affineDerivedExtension g).obj ((schemeGlobalDerivedHomOver f).obj (op M, K)) ≅
        Γ.obj ((derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj H)),
      ∃ b : Γ.obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj H)) ≅
          (schemeGlobalDerivedHomOver (pullback.snd f g)).obj
            (op ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M),
              (derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj K),
        affineGlobalHomBaseChangeMap f g M K hM hK =
          a.hom ≫ Γ.map (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
            (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition H) ≫ b.hom
